name: August Kesseler The Daily August Riesling

summary.es: August Kesseler The Daily August Riesling es un vino blanco de August Kesseler, con la denominación VDP Rheingau, en Alemania.
summary.en: August Kesseler The Daily August Riesling is a white wine from August Kesseler, made under the VDP Rheingau appellation in Germany.
summary.fr: August Kesseler The Daily August Riesling est un vin blanc de August Kesseler, élaboré sous l’appellation VDP Rheingau (Allemagne).
summary.it: August Kesseler The Daily August Riesling è un vino bianco di August Kesseler, prodotto nella denominazione VDP Rheingau (Germania).

body.es: Se elabora con Riesling. Se cría en depósitos de acero inoxidable. Su graduación es de 11 % vol.
body.en: It is made from Riesling. It is aged in stainless steel tanks. It has 11% ABV.
body.fr: Il est élaboré à partir de Riesling. Il est élevé en cuves inox. Il titre 11 % vol.
body.it: È prodotto con Riesling Renano. Affina in acciaio inox. Ha 11% vol.
